subject: Post-call: BrightLayer pricing sensitivity & residency impact
messages:
From: KarThik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@brightlayer.com>; Ethan Ward <eward@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: top-line unit economics (US vs EU)

Thanks again for taking time today — really appreciate the candid conversation. Quick recap and the one ask we promised to follow up on.

Recap (high level)
- BrightLayer use case: real-time insights in the app + nightly embedding index updates (low latency for interactive features, heavy batch embedding jobs overnight).
- Volume shape: short-chat sessions (avg 120 tokens/session) + embedding batches (approx 18M tokens/month)
- Residency requirement: engineering suggested EU-residency for EMEA customers; most US traffic stays in the US region.

Primary ask for pricing qualification:
- Can you confirm a monthly budget range you are targeting for inference (ballpark $/month)? You mentioned this is being validated with procurement.
- If it helps: the unit target your team cited on the call was ~$1,000–$1,500 per 1M interactive tokens (US), and you expected a premium for EU residency. Please confirm whether that target is per 1M tokens or per 100k tokens.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll surface a short cost comparison (US vs EU) and a recommended configuration (mix of hosted + dedicated for peak batch windows).
- Attach: draft MAP and SOW template for review.

If you can reply with a quick budget band (e.g., <$5k, $5–15k, $15–50k, >$50k) and confirm the unit metric (per 1M vs per 100k), we’ll get a tailored example P&L back to you by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Attachment: BrightLayer-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)
Attachment: SOW-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 28KB)

From: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@brightlayer.com>
To: KarThik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Ward <eward@brightlayer.com>; BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: top-line unit economics (US vs EU)

Karthik — thanks for the recap and the materials. Quick answers from our side:

- Budget band: currently scoped as $15–50k/month for inference during initial pilot (we may expand in year two).
- Unit metric: the $/1M figure we mentioned on the call was indeed per 1,000,000 tokens (not per 100k). That aligns with our internal cost modeling.
- EU residency: yes — for customers based in EMEA we need data at rest and inference within EU zones (GCP/Frankfurt preferred). That will likely introduce a 10–18% premium vs US-hosted pricing according to our compliance team.

Procurement note: I’ve looped in procurement for contract and residency questions. They’ll want a short pricing comparison and evidence of audit logs and encryption-at-rest.

Next immediate ask: can you share a very compact P&L showing unit cost at three volume points (1M, 10M, 50M tokens) for both US and EU hosting? A one-page table is perfect.

Olivia

--
Olivia Barnes
Head of Product, BrightLayer
obarnes@brightlayer.com | +44 20 7946 0123

From: KarThik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@brightlayer.com>; BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: top-line unit economics (US vs EU)

Thanks Olivia — super helpful. See below our compact P&L (summary) and assumptions. Full calc attached as a small spreadsheet in the Drive link.

Summary P&L (summary, rounded)
- 1M tokens/month
  - US: $950 / 1M tokens (hosted, mixed model)
  - EU: $1,100 / 1M tokens (residency premium + regional infra)
- 10M tokens/month
  - US: $680 / 1M tokens (better batching & dedicated reserved capacity)
  - EU: $800 / 1M tokens
- 50M tokens/month
  - US: $420 / 1M tokens (dedicated + aggressive batching/caching)
  - EU: $490 / 1M tokens

Key assumptions (very condensed)
- Interactive token avg = 120 tokens/session; embedding batches use optimized quantized runs overnight.
- EU premium modeled as +15% operational delta (network + regional infra + higher GPU spot rates in our Frankfurt clusters).
- Costs reflect model variant mix: base open model + optional quantized variant for embeddings.

Compliance items: we can produce SOC2 evidence, encryption-at-rest details, and per-request audit logs for the EU deployment. Will surface the evidence pack in the Drive link.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick sync with procurement to validate SLA/audit requirements (30 minutes) — happy to join.
2) If the P&L fits, we’ll draft a short pilot SOW (4–8 weeks) and propose a reserved capacity band for the batch window.
3) Send an internal canary plan for EU-hosted trial to the BrightLayer infra team.

I’ll attach a one-page PDF P&L and a spreadsheet in the shared Drive; aiming to have the SOW draft by Monday.

Regards,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Attachment: BL-compact-PnL-1p.pdf (application/pdf, 56KB)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1G-QL-BrightLayer-pricing

From: Ethan Ward <eward@brightlayer.com>
To: KarThik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>; Olivia Barnes <obarnes@brightlayer.com>
Cc: BrightLayer Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: top-line unit economics (US vs EU)

Karthik — quick note from procurement side. Thanks for the numbers — they look directionally reasonable. A couple of clarifications before we loop legal: 

- Can you confirm whether the EU numbers assume customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed KMS? Procurement prefers customer-managed KMS for EU-residency pilots.
- For the 10M / 50M bands, can you break out the expected reserved commit (v GPU hours or $/month) you’d expect BrightLayer to commit to get to the lower $/1M rates? We need a sense of minimums for budgeting.
- Please put the SOW template and evidence pack behind a share link we can reference in the procurement ticket.

If you can share those details by EOD, we’ll try to have legal review the pilot SOW early next week.

Thanks — Ethan

--
Ethan Ward | Head of Procurement, BrightLayer
eward@brightlayer.com | +1 (212) 555-0142
